overall: MARGINAL: calm on the Coron side, Panlaitan and Decabobo; strong east wind building on the east side tonight into Thursday
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination , led by east wind at Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Nangalao, Ciron and Barangonan (11–15 kt now, 17–21 kt overnight through Thursday morning), plus current at Tara and Turda (0.8–1.0 kt until about 9 AM Thursday) and Linapacan, Barangonan and Decabaitot (1.0–1.2 kt Thursday late morning). Rain is minor: 0.4 mm/h on the Coron side about 3–5 PM, and a 1.7 mm/h shower at Nangalao about 6–8 AM Thursday.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still lists a tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The east-wind spell is now longer and stronger, so Fri 6 supply drops from NEAR NORMAL to SLIGHTLY SOFT. Cabunlawan and Decabaitot now run 17–21 kt from about 9 PM tonight to noon Thursday (peak 21 kt about 8 AM), Nangalao 17–19.6 kt from about 8 PM to past 1 PM, and Ciron 16–19 kt. This morning's run had it ending about 5 AM Thursday.

Saturday is now the roughest day of the week (11 kt, gusts 18, 2.4 mm rain; was 10 kt, gusts 17, dry), so Sun 8 slips back from NEAR NORMAL to SLIGHTLY SOFT. Friday is still the calmest (7.2 kt, gusts 15, dry), so Sat 7 stays NORMAL. Grounds now 6 GOOD / 10 MARGINAL / 0 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (this morning 8 / 6 / 2): Tara and Turda improved to MARGINAL, while Culion and Linapacan slipped to MARGINAL. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Wed–Tue (guide only; it reacts to the 0.5–0.7 kt daily currents). Tightening risk rises to moderate: three soft arrival days in a row (Wed 4, Thu 5, Fri 6) before Saturday's rebound. Lean on the Coron side, Galoc, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo for Thursday–Friday supply.

details: Coron and Galoc: under 5 kt from about 8 PM to 9 AM Thursday, current 0.1–0.4. Panlaitan and Maglalambay: 6–8 kt with 0.1–0.3 kt current all 24h, lightest about 7–9 AM Thursday. Decabobo: under 3.4 kt from about 4 PM to noon Thursday, current 0.2–0.5 (the dashboard's best hour is about 7 AM Thursday here).
